title: The Mawdeep Warrens
changes: A sinkhole has opened in the Whispering Woods, north of the trail to Redfang Hollow. Climb down into a three-floor dungeon lit only by braziers and your own light.
The beast-folk live down there: men and women sewn into rat, boar, spider and bat hides, who fight like the animal they wear.
Two elites guard the deep floors, Gorehowl the Packlord and the Hornbrute, and the Hide-Mother waits on the last floor.
New quest line, The Hide Rite (level 21+): Captain Hale and Morwen send you down to find out where the valley's missing folk went.
